newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenbao B shares surge 9.94 pct.
newsitem.headline: Shenbao B shares surge 9.94 pct.

text.p: Shenzhen Shenbao Industrial Co Ltd B shares soared HK$0.52 or 9.94 percent to HK$5.75 in early afternoon trading on Wednesday after the company announced strong 1996 annual results, brokers said.
"The company's announcement of strong 1996 net profit fuelled the surge," an analyst with China Guotai Securities said.
"Some institutions are seen supporting the shares although follow-up buying interest was not strong," the analyst said.
On Wednesday, Shenbao posted a net profit of 42.96 million yuan for 1996 against 3.62 million for 1995 based on Chinese accounting standards.
Based on international standards, the beverage maker posted net profits of 48.37 million yuan for 1996 but it did not give a comparative figure.
Shenbao's A shares surged 1.38 yuan or 9.74 percent to 15.55 yuan on volume of 2.42 million shares.
